title: Only 222 People Have Been Cryopreserved By Alcor
closing: The gap separates paid plans from completed preservation, so membership is not the same as patients.
question: Would you pay for cryopreservation?

segments.say: Alcor had 222 cryopreserved patients. That is the completed-patient count, not everyone enrolled.
Alcor listed 1,927 living members signed up. Most of that membership had not become patients.
Whole-body preservation costs $200,000. The price describes a service plan, not a guarantee of revival.
